patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast imagery is used for hero and background sections, often with dark overlays or subtle animations to maintain text legibility.
Content sections utilize a clean, minimalist grid system with generous spacing and thin, white borders around individual items.
A dramatic, high-contrast palette of black, white, and deep red creates a sophisticated and bold aesthetic.
Prominent headings and the site logo use a condensed, uppercase sans-serif font, creating a strong, architectural feel, contrasted with a more neutral sans-serif for body text and labels.
The site features a transforming sticky header logo where individual letters condense into a single wordmark as the user scrolls down.
Background elements, such as a subtle bottle image, are rendered on a canvas and animate with parallax and rotation effects, creating a layered depth behind the scrolling content.
Main content sections slide up to obscure the initial hero image, which then darkens and subtly parallaxes, creating a smooth transition between page states.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom scroll experience, likely using locomotive-scroll, to achieve smooth, controlled scrolling and trigger various animations based on scroll depth.
Dynamic background effects, including parallaxing and subtle object rotations, are rendered on a canvas element, allowing for complex visual layering independent of the main DOM content.
Sticky header and footer elements are implemented, with the header logo undergoing a visual transformation (e.g., condensing letters) as the user scrolls, indicating scroll progress.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, regular-weight uppercase labels and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, leaning airy in the hero section, with a consistent grid rhythm in content areas.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic canvas background that subtly animates and reveals imagery behind the main content, combined with a transforming sticky header logo and a high-contrast, industrial aesthetic, sets it apart. The overall experience feels less like a static webpage and more like an interactive, layered presentation.
